title: Washingwood site-data contract
description: The interface between the pipeline and the site. Each document kind is an entry point under $defs: league, trophyShelf, ownerIndex, owner, season.

league.title: League summary
league.description: Site-wide facts shown on Home and in navigation. Exported as league.json.

seasons.description: Every Season with a Season document, oldest first.

teamCount.description: Number of Franchises in the Season.

champion.description: The Champion of the most recent Season.

teamName.description: The Champion Franchise's team name that Season.

year.description: The Season the title was won.

trophyShelf.title: Trophy shelf
trophyShelf.description: Every Owner's career honours, shown on Home. Exported as trophy-shelf.json.

owners.description: One entry per Owner, former Owners included. Ordered by title count, then runner-up count (both descending), then name.

currentTeamName.description: Current team name: the team name of the Owner's most recent Franchise.

titles.description: Seasons the Owner was Champion, oldest first.

runnerUps.description: Seasons the Owner lost the championship Matchup, oldest first.

firstSeason.description: The Owner's first Season in the League.

lastSeason.description: The Owner's most recent Season in the League.

isFormer.description: True if the Owner has no Franchise in the most recent Season.

ownerIndex.title: Owner index
ownerIndex.description: Every Owner, for the Owners index page. Exported as owners.json.

owners.description: One entry per Owner, former Owners included. Ordered like the trophy shelf: title count, then runner-up count (both descending), then name.

currentTeamName.description: Current team name: the team name of the Owner's most recent Franchise.

firstSeason.description: The Owner's first Season in the League.

lastSeason.description: The Owner's most recent Season in the League.

isFormer.description: True if the Owner has no Franchise in the most recent Season.

titles.description: Seasons the Owner was Champion, oldest first.

runnerUps.description: Seasons the Owner lost the championship Matchup, oldest first.

regularSeason.description: Career regular-season record: the sum of the Owner's records in each Season's standings. Playoff and consolation Matchups are not included.

owner.title: Owner document
owner.description: Everything one Owner's page shows. Exported as owners/<slug>.json.
The Owner. The file name is its slug.

currentTeamName.description: Current team name: the team name of the Owner's most recent Franchise.

firstSeason.description: The Owner's first Season in the League.

lastSeason.description: The Owner's most recent Season in the League.

isFormer.description: True if the Owner has no Franchise in the most recent Season.

titles.description: Seasons the Owner was Champion, oldest first.

runnerUps.description: Seasons the Owner lost the championship Matchup, oldest first.

thirds.description: Seasons the Owner won the Third-place game, oldest first.

regularSeason.description: Career regular-season record: the sum of the Owner's records in each Season's standings.

playoffs.description: Career Playoff record: championship-bracket Matchups played. Byes, the Third-place game and consolation Matchups are excluded; a two-week round counts once.

avgPointsFor.description: Regular-season points for per game across the career (standings points for / regular-season games), rounded to 2 decimals.

avgPointsAgainst.description: Regular-season points against per game across the career, rounded to 2 decimals.

playoffAppearances.description: Seasons with a Playoff appearance (seed within the playoff field; a bye counts), oldest first.

lastPlaces.description: Seasons the Owner finished Last place (highest playoff seed), oldest first.

seasons.description: One row per Season the Owner played, newest first.

teamName.description: The Owner's team name that Season.

record.description: Regular-season record, as in that Season's standings.

pointsFor.description: Points for, as in that Season's standings.

pointsAgainst.description: Points against, as in that Season's standings.

finalRank.description: Final place that Season, as in that Season's standings.

podiumPlace.description: 1, 2 or 3 for a Podium finish, otherwise null.

isLastPlace.description: True if the Owner was that Season's Last place.

draft.description: The Owner's Picks, one entry per Season they played, newest first.

teamName.description: The Owner's team name that Season.

slot.description: The Owner's Draft slot that Season (their round-1 pick number).

grade.description: The Owner's Draft grade that Season: rank within the Season (ties share the better rank), out of how many Franchises, and the total Value over slot.

rank.description: Rank within the Season, 1 = best Draft.

total.description: The sum of the Owner's Value over slot that Season.

picks.description: The Owner's Picks that Season, in pick order. The first is their round-1 Pick.

player.description: The Player taken, or null when no Player was recorded for the Pick.

points.description: The Player's Season points: the platform's season total under that Season's scoring, covering the whole NFL regular season (from 2021 that includes week 18). Null when no Player was recorded.

positionalFinish.description: Positional finish: the Player's rank by Season points among every Player at their position that Season, drafted or not (shown as e.g. RB3). Ties share the better rank. Null when no Player was recorded.

valueOverSlot.description: Value over slot: the Pick's order among that Season's Picks at its position (1 = the first QB taken), minus its finish by Season points among the drafted Players at that position (ties share the better finish). Positive is a steal, negative a bust. Null when no Player was recorded; such Picks are left out.

headToHead.description: One row per opponent Owner played at least once, former Owners included. Ordered by meetings (descending), then opponent name.

regularSeason.description: The Owner's record against this opponent in regular-season Matchups.

playoffs.description: The Owner's record against this opponent under the Playoff record rule.

meetings.description: Regular-season plus playoff Matchups between the two (consolation and Third-place games excluded). Never 0.

draft.title: Draft history document
draft.description: The Draft section: every Season's first round. Exported as draft.json.

seasons.description: One entry per Season, newest first.

year.description: The Season. Its full board is on the Season page's Draft tab.

teamCount.description: Number of Franchises, so the number of first-round Picks.

type.description: How the Draft was run, as in the Season document's draft.type.

firstRound.description: The round-1 Picks in pick order: one per Franchise.

overall.description: Overall pick number, which in round 1 is also the Draft slot.

owner.description: The Owner of the Franchise that made the Pick.

teamName.description: That Franchise's team name that Season.

player.description: The Player taken, or null when no Player was recorded for the Pick.

bestPicks.description: The 10 Picks with the highest Value over slot across every Season (fewer if there are fewer recorded Picks). Ordered by Value over slot (descending), then Season, then overall pick.

worstPicks.description: The 10 Picks with the lowest Value over slot across every Season. Ordered by Value over slot (ascending), then Season, then overall pick.

bestDrafters.description: Every Owner who has drafted, by average Draft grade rank across their Seasons (ascending), then name.

seasons.description: Seasons counted: every Season the Owner drafted in.

averageRank.description: Mean of the Owner's Draft grade ranks, rounded to 2 decimals. Lower is better.

allTimePick.description: A recorded Pick named in the all-time best or worst Picks.

owner.description: The Owner of the Franchise that made the Pick.

teamName.description: That Franchise's team name that Season.

positionalFinish.description: The Player's Positional finish that Season.

matchups.title: Matchups document
matchups.description: The Matchups section: championship cards and leaderboards (later also the rivalry grid). Exported as matchups.json.

championships.description: One card per Season's championship Matchup, newest first. Each matches that Season's bracket.

weeks.description: The NFL Weeks it spans; two for a two-week final, whose scores are combined.

margin.description: Margin: the Champion's score minus the runner-up's, rounded to 2 decimals.

leaderboards.description: Top-10 lists over the Counted Matchups (GLOSSARY). Ties are ordered by Season, then Week, then Owner name (the winner's, or the team's on the score lists).

highestScores.description: Highest single-side scores first. Each side counts on its own, so one Matchup can appear twice.

lowestScores.description: Lowest single-side scores first. Each side counts on its own.

playoffUpsets.description: Playoff upsets by seed gap (largest first), then Margin.

leaderboardSide.description: One Franchise's side of a Counted Matchup on a leaderboard.

teamName.description: The Franchise's team name that Season.

score.description: Points scored in the Matchup, as ESPN recorded them (manual adjustments excluded).

seed.description: The Franchise's playoff seed in a playoff Matchup; null in the regular season.

leaderboardGame.description: A Counted Matchup on the blowouts or closest-games leaderboard.

weeks.description: The single NFL Week it was played in (two-week rounds aren't Counted Matchups).

kind.description: regular = regular season; playoff = a championship-bracket Matchup.

winner.description: The winning side; on a tie, the home side.

loser.description: The losing side; on a tie, the away side.

isTie.description: True if the Matchup ended level.

margin.description: Margin: the winner's score minus the loser's, rounded to 2 decimals (0 on a tie).

scoringFormat.description: The Season's Scoring format label (e.g. PPR, Standard + TE premium). Scores across formats aren't comparable.

leaderboardUpset.description: A Playoff upset: a championship-bracket Counted Matchup won by the worse seed.

weeks.description: The single NFL Week it was played in (two-week rounds aren't Counted Matchups).

kind.description: regular = regular season; playoff = a championship-bracket Matchup.

winner.description: The winning side; on a tie, the home side.

loser.description: The losing side; on a tie, the away side.

isTie.description: True if the Matchup ended level.

margin.description: Margin: the winner's score minus the loser's, rounded to 2 decimals (0 on a tie).

scoringFormat.description: The Season's Scoring format label (e.g. PPR, Standard + TE premium). Scores across formats aren't comparable.

seedGap.description: The winner's seed minus the loser's.

leaderboardScore.description: One side's score in a Counted Matchup, on the highest- or lowest-score leaderboard.

weeks.description: The single NFL Week it was played in (two-week rounds aren't Counted Matchups).

kind.description: regular = regular season; playoff = a championship-bracket Matchup.

team.description: The side whose score this row is about.

scoringFormat.description: The Season's Scoring format label (e.g. PPR, Standard + TE premium). Scores across formats aren't comparable.

season.title: Season document
season.description: Everything the Season page shows for one Season. Exported as seasons/<year>.json.

teamCount.description: Number of Franchises in the Season.

dataTier.description: Data tier: how much detail survives for the Season. full = lineups, player stats, transactions; partial = league-level results, some detail missing.

label.description: Headline format, e.g. "PPR", "Half PPR", "Standard", "PPR + TE premium".

receptionPoints.description: Points per reception for non-TE positions.

tePremium.description: Extra points per reception for a TE, on top of receptionPoints. 0 when there is no TE premium.

keyValues.description: Headline scoring values to display, in display order.

label.description: What is scored, with its unit, e.g. "Passing TD" or "Rushing yard".

points.description: Points awarded for one unit (negative for penalties).

rosterSlots.description: Lineup slots, in display order. Slots with a count of 0 are omitted.

slot.description: Slot label: QB, RB, WR, TE, FLEX, D/ST, K, BE or IR.

count.description: How many of this slot a Franchise has.

draft.description: The Season's Draft: its order and every Pick, in pick order.

type.description: How the Draft was run: snake (the order reverses each round) or offline (run off the platform and entered by hand afterwards, still in snake order).

order.description: The round-1 order: one entry per Franchise, by Draft slot.

slot.description: Draft slot: the Franchise's pick number in round 1, 1..teamCount.

teamName.description: The Franchise's team name that Season.

picks.description: Every Pick, ordered by overall pick number (1..teamCount x rounds).

grades.description: Draft grades: one entry per Franchise, ordered by rank, then Owner name. A Draft grade is the sum of the Franchise's Value over slot, ranked within the Season; ties share the better rank.

rank.description: Rank within the Season, 1 = best Draft.

teamName.description: The Franchise's team name that Season.

total.description: The sum of the Franchise's Value over slot.

best.description: The Franchise's Pick with the highest Value over slot (the earliest Pick on a tie).

worst.description: The Franchise's Pick with the lowest Value over slot (the earliest Pick on a tie).

note.description: A caveat shown with the board, e.g. for an offline Draft with Picks not recorded. Null when there is nothing to say.

podium.description: The Podium: Champion, runner-up and Third-place game winner, in that order.

lastPlace.description: Last place: the Franchise with the highest playoffSeed (worst regular-season standing). Not derived from final rank.

teamName.description: The Last place Franchise's team name that Season.

punishment.description: The Season's Punishment. Always null in v1; the site shows "Punishment details coming soon".

standings.description: Final standings, one entry per Franchise, ordered by rank.

rank.description: Final finish, 1 = Champion. Includes playoff and consolation results.

teamName.description: The Franchise's team name that Season.

pointsFor.description: Regular-season points scored, including manual score adjustments (matches ESPN).

pointsAgainst.description: Regular-season points scored against the Franchise.

playoffSeed.description: Regular-season rank 1..teamCount with ESPN tiebreakers applied. The highest seed is Last place.

rounds.description: Playoff rounds in order; the last is the championship, holding exactly one Matchup.

matchupPeriod.description: The Matchup period the round is played in.

weeks.description: The NFL Weeks the round spans. Two Weeks for a two-week round, whose scores are combined.

matchups.description: The round's Matchups, including first-round byes.

thirdPlaceGame.description: The Third-place game: the two semifinal losers. Its winner takes 3rd.

matchupPeriod.description: The Matchup period it is played in (the championship's period).

matchup.description: The Matchup itself. Never a bye.

weeklyResults.description: Every Matchup period in the Season, regular season and playoffs, in order.

weeks.description: The NFL Weeks the Matchup period spans.

matchups.description: Every Matchup in the period, consolation Matchups and byes included.

roundPick.description: Pick within the round, from 1. Shown as round.pick, e.g. 3.07.

owner.description: The Owner of the Franchise that made the Pick.

player.description: The Player taken, or null when no Player was recorded for the Pick.

points.description: The Player's Season points: the platform's season total under that Season's scoring, covering the whole NFL regular season (from 2021 that includes week 18). Null when no Player was recorded.

positionalFinish.description: Positional finish: the Player's rank by Season points among every Player at their position that Season, drafted or not (shown as e.g. RB3). Ties share the better rank. Null when no Player was recorded.

valueOverSlot.description: Value over slot: the Pick's order among that Season's Picks at its position (1 = the first QB taken), minus its finish by Season points among the drafted Players at that position (ties share the better finish). Positive is a steal, negative a bust. Null when no Player was recorded; such Picks are left out.

gradedPick.description: A recorded Pick with its Value over slot, as named in a Draft grade.

draftPlayer.description: A drafted Player, as of that Season.

position.description: Position: QB, RB, WR, TE, K, D/ST (others are possible but rare).

nflTeam.description: NFL team abbreviation that Season, e.g. KC. One value per Season, so not necessarily the team on draft day. Null for a free agent.

teamName.description: The Franchise's team name that Season.

punishment.description: A filled-in Punishment. Not produced in v1.

description.description: What the Owner had to do.

image.description: Site path of the picture, or null if there is none. Served behind the passphrase like everything else.

matchupPeriod.description: A Matchup period number, starting at 1.

weeks.description: NFL Week numbers, ascending, no repeats.

weeklySide.description: One Franchise's side of a Matchup in weekly results.

teamName.description: The Franchise's team name that Season.

score.description: Points scored over the Matchup period, without manual adjustments (as ESPN shows them). On a bye, the points ESPN recorded for the Franchise that Week, or null if none.

bracketSide.description: One Franchise's side of a playoff bracket Matchup.

teamName.description: The Franchise's team name that Season.

score.description: Points scored over the round, combined across both Weeks of a two-week round. Null only on a bye.

matchupRules.description: Consistency rules shared by every Matchup. A bye has no away side, no winner and is not a tie (its one score is optional). Otherwise both sides have a score; a tie has no winner; anything else names its winner.

home.description: The home side. On a bye, the Franchise on the bye.

away.description: The away side; null on a bye.

winner.description: Which side won: "home", "away", or null for a tie or bye.

isTie.description: True if both sides scored the same.

isBye.description: True if the home Franchise had no opponent.

bracketMatchup.description: One Matchup in the playoff bracket.

home.description: The home side (the higher seed). On a bye, the Franchise on the bye.

away.description: The away side; null on a bye.

winner.description: Which side advanced: "home" or "away". Null on a bye (the home Franchise advances without playing) or a tie.

isTie.description: True if both sides scored the same. ESPN breaks playoff ties, so the exporter should rarely set this.

yearList.description: A set of Season years, oldest first, no repeats.

ownerRef.description: A reference to an Owner: a stable slug plus display name. The same slug always carries the same name.

slug.description: Stable, URL-safe identifier for the Owner. Lowercase words joined by hyphens. Never an ESPN ID (ADR-0002).

year.description: A Season's year. Recorded history starts in 2018.

teamCount.description: Number of Franchises in a Season.
